title: glue1
description: A station at a fixed position on the shopfloor that realises one service. Each of its Actions runs one recipe: it produces the recipe's output product at the station's own position and consumes the recipe's inputs, whose state becomes 'consumed' and whose position becomes null. An Action has no effect unless every input product of that recipe already lies at the station. The Actions themselves differ per station and are given in the instance Thing Descriptions.

temperature.title: Current temperature of the station's glue gun in degrees celsius

target-temperature.title: Temperature that the station's glue gun is supposed to have in degrees celsius

max-temperature-deviation.title: Maximum  degrees celsius that the station's glue gun max be above or below the target temperature

produceCaseWithBattery.title: produce caseWithBattery
produceCaseWithBattery.description: Run the caseWithBattery recipe: consume the given battery, caseWithSensorModule and place the given caseWithBattery at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.

battery.title: battery
battery.description: The battery to consume: 'battery' for the generic battery product, or the id of one of the battery spare parts, which is its manufacturer part number (schema:mpn) in lowercase.

caseWithSensorModule.title: caseWithSensorModule
caseWithSensorModule.description: The caseWithSensorModule to consume, by id.

caseWithBattery.title: caseWithBattery
caseWithBattery.description: The caseWithBattery to build, by id.

produceDisplayUnit.title: produce displayUnit
produceDisplayUnit.description: Run the displayUnit recipe: consume the given glass, lcd and place the given displayUnit at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.
